PR #484 — cleanup(interfaces): retire cache admin UI and routes

状态： MERGED
作者： rustburn
创建： 2026-09-14T06:51:59Z
Base： main@1545eec83ed3
Head： cleanup/retire-cache-admin-interfaces-483@0b4ff0d3456e
完整 E2E 拓扑基线： burncloud/burncloud@aa54e21393c6d46a6b09555ffd3661c1f22484f3
证据规则： PR changed files / patch 为 STATIC CONFIRMED；下方完整 E2E 使用当前已审计 Atlas 拓扑，并在命中 PR changed file 的节点标记 [PR CHANGED]。旧 PR 的历史 head 可能与当前拓扑存在后续演化，因此未把当前拓扑伪装成历史源码逐行复现。

PR 影响总览​

  • Change Class： RUNTIME + UI
  • Changed Files： 6
  • Additions / Deletions： +1 / -150
  • 受影响的完整 E2E Flow： 49
  • 未映射 changed files： 4

PR 说明摘要： ## Summary Closes #483. Apply the retirement decision from #482 across both sides of the internal UI↔Server contract: - remove Server cache API module and route registration; - delete GET /console/api/cache/stats and POST /console/api/cache/clear; - remove Client request functions; - remove Settings cache statistics and maintenance UI; - remove obsolete functional-wiring requirements; - remove the old 401 test that could not distinguish a protected route from a removed route. ## Boundary This PR changes Interfaces only. It intentionally leaves CacheService, Server AppState, startup initialization, the Cache crate, and dependencies for the next Platform cleanup Issue. Changed/deleted only: - crates/server/src/api/mod.rs - crates/server/src/api/cache.rs (deleted) - crates/server/tests/api_tests.rs - crates/client/src/functional_api.rs - crates/client/src/functional_pages/settings.rs - crates/client/scripts/check-functional-wiring.sh Unchanged: - admin middleware and all other admin routes; - Environment and Runtime health Settings; - authentication, billing, routing, database, CacheService, Redis, and directory layout. ## Verification Completed: - git diff --check main...HEAD; - bash crates/client/scripts/check-functional-wiring.sh → Functional console wiring OK; - static search confirms no retired Cache path, Client function, Settings resource, or Serve…

E2E FLOW #46 — System Monitor Auto Update​

树路径： Background Jobs / Async Side Effects → Long-running Jobs → System Monitor Auto Update
PR Impact： STATIC SOURCE-PATH MATCH
本 Flow 命中的 changed files： crates/server/src/api/mod.rs

START / TRIGGER
│
├─ Trigger source
│    ├─ startup spawn / request-time tokio::spawn / manager restoration / channel message
│    └─ task: System Monitor Auto Update
│
├─ Spawn / registration
│    ├─ parent runtime creates async task/thread/loop
│    └─ DECISION: spawn/runtime handle available?
│         ├─ NO → task never starts; parent may log error
│         └─ YES → task owns/borrows required shared state
│
├─ Wait boundary
│    ├─ timer sleep / mpsc receive / polling interval / restored work item
│    └─ DECISION: trigger/event available?
│         ├─ NO → continue waiting
│         └─ YES → one iteration begins
│
├─ Input snapshot
│    ├─ read latest runtime/DB/request-derived state needed by job
│    └─ freeze iteration context
│
├─ Core job operation
│    ├─ execute System Monitor Auto Update
│    └─ may call DB / HTTP / filesystem / runtime service depending on task
│
├─ Operation result
│    └─ DECISION: iteration succeeds?
│         ├─ NO
│         │    ├─ log/record failure
│         │    ├─ preserve parent request availability when task is fail-open
│         │    └─ decide retry on next event/interval
│         └─ YES
│              ├─ update in-memory state and/or persistent state
│              └─ emit success telemetry/log
│
├─ Cancellation / lifetime
│    └─ DECISION: parent runtime still alive AND task should continue?
│         ├─ YES → 返回等待边界
│         └─ NO → release task resources
│

├─ Background OS thread
